_comment: Hand-authored release manifest TEMPLATE. Tracked by git. Every field here is a human decision. Scripts/build-release.sh copies this file and adds the computed fields (checksums, sizes, sourceCommit, releaseTag, buildDate, buildInvocationID, treeState) to produce dist/latest.json, which is NEVER committed -- a tracked file cannot contain the SHA of the commit that adds it, and trying made the manifest permanently one commit stale. See Documentation/RELEASE_PROVENANCE.md.
knownLimitations: Unsigned, not notarized: Gatekeeper will block first launch (see Documentation/INSTALL_UNSIGNED.md). Scripts/build-release.sh replaces this line for a Developer ID signed + notarized release.
This manifest carries no downloadURL field; download links are the GitHub release page's own asset URLs.

The trademark screening found no mark containing 'coretend' across ~141.8M records on TMview; on 2026-09-02 a trademark attorney reviewed the nearest neighbour COREXTEND (MIPS Tech, class 9) and concluded there is no conflict — two entirely separate products with two entirely separate meanings. This is not a trademark registration and no application has been filed.
